title: Posting summaries file
description: The shape of site/data/summaries.json, written by pipeline.publish beside board.json and loaded by site/index.html the first time a reader opens "From the posting". Owned by workstream A4. Each distinct text is stored once; a role in board.json points to its text with `sm`.

generated_at.description: The same as board.json's: the page uses the file only when they match.

items.description: A posting's summary, cut to 300 characters at a sentence end or a word (with an ellipsis).
